newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes weaker, dollar demand strong.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes weaker, dollar demand strong.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed weaker on Thursday as dollar demand kept the local unit from benefiting from a rise in call rates, dealers said. The taka ended at 43.7550/7600 to the dollar, against a previous close of 43.7540/7560 and opening at 43.7500/7600.

Call money rose to seven to eight percent against 5.0-5.5 percent on Wednesday, reflecting a liquidity shortfall after banks made payments on central bank bills which caused the outflow of about 4.75 billion taka. The bills were auctioned on Wednesday. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
